name: Gazpacho (Chilled Veggie Soup) with Lemon-Parsley Shrimp Salad Toasts

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ yellow bell peppers
6 tomatoes
1 ½ lemons
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice bread and transfer to a large bowl.
Peel, trim, and large dice cucumbers; add to the bowl with the bread.
Trim, seed, and large dice bell peppers. Large dice tomatoes; add both to the bowl.
Peel and roughly chop garlic; add to the bowl along with broth, oil, vinegar, and spices; stir to combine the soup mixture.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp onion powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches, transfer the soup mixture to a blender; blend on high until semi-smooth. Once blended, transfer gazpacho to a container with a lid and refrigerate until ready to serve. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top. Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil.

Divide shrimp between the baking sheets, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper. Working in batches, place each baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping once, until shrimp are opaque and cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the shrimp are cooking, mince capers. Place in the reserved bowl along with mayo and crushed red pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp capers
½ cup mayonnaise
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into the bowl with the capers and stir to combine.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl (reserving a small handful for serving).

Carefully remove cooked shrimp from the baking sheets by lifting the corners of the foil and transferring each foil sheet to a flat surface. Divide additional bread slices between the baking sheets; working in batches, place in the oven, and broil until toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, roughly chop the cooked shrimp; add to the bowl with the lemon-mayo mixture and stir to combine. Divide shrimp salad between toast slices and spread out in an even layer.
Divide gazpacho between bowls; drizzle with additional oil and sprinkle with reserved parsley. Serve with shrimp salad toasts on the side and enjoy!
